niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, modern, airy interfaces that feel finished and app-like, with strong visual hierarchy, clear sectioning, and enough content density to feel complete. They like concise, task-focused copy, prominent primary actions, and straightforward controls. They generally prefer light backgrounds and balanced spacing, but will choose dark/premium styling in some alert or card contexts when it feels more polished and clearly structured.

criteria.description: Strong headline/section hierarchy with obvious primary content and clear grouping.
Open, airy spacing that avoids crowding while still feeling intentionally filled.
More visible settings, rows, or options that make the screen feel complete rather than sparse.
Short, direct, reassuring text that explains the task without verbose tutorial-style messaging.
A prominent, easy-to-spot main CTA that stands out clearly from secondary actions.
Straightforward toggles, rows, and navigation affordances with minimal control ambiguity.
A contemporary, finished, app-like look with clean cards, refined icon treatment, and cohesive styling.
